item.text: I found Tomas’s email with the venue and schedule. It says the room was on hold and that he planned to pay the deposit, but I can’t confirm whether the deposit was paid or the booking was finalized. “Team” is not defined in your profile, and the email names five invitees including Tomas (who says he’ll miss it), so I’ll need to limit the invite to those named unless I can identify their addresses. The calendar tool adds events to your calendar, not sends invitations. I’ll check whether their addresses are available in messages.

I couldn’t send a team invite. Tomas’s email gives the details—Harbor Room at Pier 9 Events, Friday 16 October, 9:00–17:00, for Priya, Lucia, Jonas, Amara, you, and Tomas—but it doesn’t include their email addresses. The available calendar tool only adds events to your calendar; it can’t send invitations.

The email says Tomas planned to pay a 30% deposit by 9 October, but I couldn’t confirm whether he did or whether the hold became a confirmed booking. The room, AV, and lunch were listed at $1,400, with parking in the Pier 9 lot via the Embarcadero entrance.
